top_signals.title: Copper Edges Lower After World’s Biggest Mine Averts Strike
top_signals.summary: Copper slipped after BHP Group’s Escondida mine in Chile, the world’s largest, averted a strike that would have tightened supply as the industry struggles to keep pace with demand from data centers and power grids.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: FBI raids DPRK IT worker laptop farms in Texas, US nationals arrested
top_signals.summary: The U.S. Department of Justice (DoJ) has disrupted the Famous Chollima threat group's operations by arresting two suspects, charging 14 individuals, and seizing nearly 187 laptops used in North Korean remote IT worker schemes. [...]
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
